length_search: None; retain initial L=20 for this bounded first study
selection_rule: Common learning rate minimizes mean of the two matched poolings' best validation LogLoss at seed 42; exact ties prefer 0.0005
epoch_rule: Each run uses its minimum validation LogLoss epoch; exact ties prefer earlier epoch
mismatch_rule: Inherit common selected configuration, no independent search
context: Frozen original seed-42 DeepFM F123 model and scaler; not retrained
time_assumption: Exposure timestamp proxies positive record time; feedback available next Beijing date, source date strictly before target date; no independent click timestamp
test_gate: Stop after committing frozen configuration, all selected checkpoints and validation evidence; no sequence test inference
planned_comparisons: matched minus mismatched within each pooling
calibration_plan: After separate test authorization, retain historical validation impression-hash 80/20 method selection between Platt and isotonic and full-validation refit; never use test to choose method
inference_plan: Evaluate the already selected checkpoints for all three seeds once; do not retrain on train+validation or revise configuration after test
statistical_claims: Three residual seeds conditional on one frozen DeepFM checkpoint; validation selection is not an unbiased held-out estimate; paired user bootstrap deferred
